facts.fact: eriinfo reports that licensing, authorisation and registration of payment institutions moved to the South African Reserve Bank when its recognition of the Payments Association of South Africa lapsed on 2 September 2026.
facts.system: South African Reserve Bank payment system functions

facts.fact: eriinfo reports that the Reserve Bank took over the clearing houses for card and high-value payments and holds 50% of PayInc, which now runs low-value payments including instant payments.
eriinfo reports that a directive requires banks in the Common Monetary Area to migrate low-value cross-border payments from the SADC real-time gross settlement system to TCIB by March 2027.
